sources.title: NV-Reason-CT: 3D Visual Language Model for CT Analysis
sources.snippet: We present NV-Reason-CT, a generative vision--language model for chest and abdominal CT combining native 3D visual encoding with radiologist-guided reasoning. The model couples a native 3D vision transformer with a language model, passing all visual tokens and their explicit 3D coordinates into language decoding without further spatial token merging. sources.title: Introducing NV-Reason-CT Open 3D CT VLM for Radiologist Chain-of ...
sources.snippet: NV-Reason-CXR reasoning methodology extends to 3D CT analysis with NV-Reason-CT, a vision language model purpose-built for volumetric imaging. The model combines a full 3D vision transformer encoder with a Qwen3.5-4B language model trained to generate chain-of-thought reasoning that mirrors radiologist systematic review of anatomical regions.
